summary: Iteration 8 — frontend-only verification of the 'preview aint working' crash fix on '/' plus quick regression on marketplace pages. Landing page now renders fully with NO pageerror and no 'lenderCount is not defined'. Offers ticker, big-stats strip (bs-lenders shows dynamic 114+), Lender Wall CTA ('View all 114+ banks & NBFCs' -> /banks) and partner-recruit section all verified. Regressions on /banks (114+, groups Private Bank 18 / PSU Bank 12 ... rendered), /become-partner (hero + calculator + 8 form inputs), /login (Google-only sign-in renders) and /channel-partners as super_admin (KPIs, leaderboard, 5 partner rows, partner detail modal with trend + target) all pass.

issues: Hardcoded '120+' still used in the offers ticker ('120+ banks & NBFCs on-board'), LENDER_COUNT_LABEL badge in the Lender Wall ('120+ Lender Partners') and partner-recruit copy ('Access 120+ lenders'), while the dynamic count from /api/public/lenders is 114. Mixed 40+/120+/114+ claims on the same page look inconsistent.
Right half of the dark hero band is completely empty (no illustration/stat card), leaving a large unbalanced void at 1920px.

action_items: Optional: drive the ticker/badge/partner-copy lender numbers from the same lenderCount state instead of the hardcoded 120+ literals.
Optional: fill the empty right side of the /banks hero.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.jsx is ~708 lines and mixes many sections + small helper components; consider splitting into section components for maintainability.

Two separate useEffects each firing a single GET is fine, but the /public/lenders catch swallows errors silently — no fallback UI signal if the count fetch fails (defaults to 120, which then contradicts the 114 elsewhere).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing session token test_session_supertoken (validated via /api/auth/me -> 200).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — login is Google-only (no email/password form), so admin sign-in was verified using the session_token cookie 'test_session_supertoken' (super_admin) which authorised /channel-partners.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 crash on '/' is fixed (lenderCount state + /public/lenders useEffect at LandingPage.jsx L63/67). No console pageerrors on '/'; only two benign 401s (unauthenticated /api/auth/me). /login has no credential form — use the session_token cookie for CRM route testing.
rca_of_the_issue: Original crash: LandingPage.jsx referenced lenderCount at lines 482 and 500 without declaring the state, throwing 'lenderCount is not defined' during render and blanking '/'. Fix (declared state + fetch of /api/public/lenders) verified working; live value 114 renders in both usages.
